description: Where function hooks are on: the two judges, installed with the plugin but armed only once skill.prompt sees /enable or /tenacity in this session, never by installation — classic.Stop and classic.SubagentStop judged by the session's own model on the turn's last message alone, every failure of the judge's own allowing the stop and handing it to the classic command hook beneath; a session.compact hook that, with work in flight, appends the work-file note and the instrument's status to the compaction instructions; a skill.prompt line per preloaded discipline skill, the measurement of whether a preload reaches a spawned agent; a status line under the prompt with the one work in flight, its stage and its next: command, pinned at session.start where work is in flight and refreshed at each turn.complete once the flow was entered; after a Write or Edit that lands on a snapshot, the instrument's count of it as context beneath the tool result; and the map as a pane beside the transcript, /genius-map to show or hide it, opened on its own where work is in flight unless the person closed it, drawn from the instrument's status and refreshed with the status line
